Plot trade as a network: capacities and flows between regions

Source: R/plot_trade_network.R
plot_trade_network.Rd

Draws trade objects as a network of regions (nodes) and links, one link per pair of regions and commodity, its width set by a value: the input capacities of the trade objects, the solved trade capacity (vTradeCap), or the solved flows (vTradeIr). Links are quadratic curves whose bends are flipped to reduce crossings.

Nodes are placed at region centroids when a map (an sf object or a geoscales::GeoScale) is given or the model carries a geoscale; otherwise they are laid out on a circle and no geography is needed.

Usage

plot_trade_network(
  object,
  map = NULL,
  value = c("input", "capacity", "flow"),
  year = NULL,
  timeslice = "ANNUAL",
  level = NULL,
  curvature = 0.15,
  labels = TRUE,
  node_size = TRUE,
  ...
)

Arguments

object

a trade, a list of trades, or a repository, model or scenario (all of whose trade objects are drawn). value = "capacity" and "flow" need a solved scenario.

map

optional sf object with region (and x, y) columns, or a geoscales::GeoScale. When NULL, the object's geoscale is used if it has one, else a circular layout.

value

what sets the link width:

  • "input": the trade objects' @capacity in year – existing links (stock > 0) solid, width = stock, with a faint band up to cap.up; projects (no stock, expandable through ncap.up, cap.up or an @invcost row) dashed, width = cap.up (else ncap.up);

  • "capacity": the solved vTradeCap in year;

  • "flow": the solved vTradeIr in year, netted per pair; the arrow points in the net direction.

year

the year to draw; default the first year present.

timeslice

for value = "flow": "ANNUAL" (default), the year's total as getData(timeframe = "lowest") returns it (weighted to the full year on a sampled calendar); or any timeslice of the calendar – a day, an hour – for that snapshot.

level

for a geoscale map: the level to draw; routes are lifted to it and those inside one region dropped.

curvature

bend of the links as a share of their length (0 = straight).

labels

draw region names.

node_size

scale nodes by the total value of their links.

...

unused.

Value

a ggplot object.

Examples

if (FALSE) { # \dontrun{
plot_trade_network(repo)                                  # inputs, circular layout
plot_trade_network(scen, value = "capacity", year = 2050) # solved capacity on the map
plot_trade_network(scen, value = "flow", timeslice = "d180_h18")
} # }
